name: @glyph-engine/desktop
description: GlyphEngine in a native window: run() draws through SDL3 (OpenGL, Vulkan, SDL GPU or software) via bun:ffi. Linux for now; needs SDL3 and SDL3_ttf.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --target bun --outdir dist --external @glyph-engine/core && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
